name: Financial Analysis Demo
description: Three project scenarios of increasing complexity for classroom illustration of Payback, NPV, IRR, and PI.

scenarios.name: Capital Investment — Manufacturing Line
scenarios.description: A $500,000 investment in an automated production line with a 10-year horizon at 12% discount rate. Cash flows ramp up over years 1-3, peak in years 4-7, then decline as the technology ages. Year 2 includes a $15,000 maintenance hit. Demonstrates uneven cash flows with clear ramp-up/decline pattern.

scenarios.name: Lease vs Buy — Server Infrastructure
scenarios.description: Buy option: $280,000 upfront for on-premise servers generating $75,000/yr savings over 6 years at 8% discount rate. Compare against lease alternative ($60,000/yr for 6 years). The buy option looks expensive upfront but has a positive NPV — a non-obvious winner.

scenarios.name: Digital Product — SaaS Platform
scenarios.description: A $150,000 investment in a SaaS product with exponential revenue growth over 5 years at 10% discount rate. Year 1 is mostly development with minimal revenue, then adoption accelerates. High-IRR scenario illustrating software economics.
